posts.title: Long weekend ends rainy on Sunday in central Indiana

posts.title: LeBron James and 76ers breeze past Pacers 111-87, advance to NBA Cup knockout round
posts.description: INDIANAPOLIS (AP) — LeBron James had 21 points, seven rebounds and six assists, and the Philadelphia 76ers breezed past the Indiana Pacers 111-87 on Friday night to win East Group B and advance to the knockout round of the NBA Cup.
